a: The record an AI learns from, and the files you hand it to work on
It runs under the street and carries the rain away
It rings at six on a school day
Where the corn and the soybeans grow
What every page needs on it before it goes out
d: Called at home plate when the slide beats the tag
What the board shows when the flight runs late
Knowing what is going on around you
The fine print you agree to before you sign up
What you open wide for a hug
n: Data is the record. Every AI tool runs on two of them: the record it learned from, and the record you hand it today. The second one is yours to choose. Before you paste in a file, ask what is in it, whose it is, and what the terms say happens to it after you send it.
